guide.title: Start with the mechanism
guide.text: A looped transformer applies a shared transformation repeatedly to a hidden state. Keep three choices separate: which layers repeat, how many times they repeat, and whether the loop count changes at inference.

guide.title: Choose a reading path
guide.text: Read Universal Transformers for the architecture, Huginn for recurrent-depth pretraining, Training-Free Looped Transformers for retrofitting, LoopCoder-v2 for parallel looping, and Loop the Loopies for compute-matched pretraining.

guide.title: Separate the compute budgets
guide.text: A fixed pretraining budget and a variable inference budget answer different questions. Compare parameter count, training compute, inference latency, and KV-cache use separately. A result at one loop count does not establish a universal optimum.

guide.title: Understand the taxonomy
guide.text: The collection has six broad reading areas. Original fine-grained topics remain searchable on every record, and a paper can belong to more than one area. Core papers are a reading route rather than a separate research category.

guide.title: Read claims with their conditions
guide.text: Check the baseline, data budget, model size, and evaluation setting before comparing results. The collection's listed year follows the existing catalog and may be a venue year rather than the first preprint date. External articles are context, not evidence of a proprietary model's architecture.
